{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk-satin blouse, relaxed fit with a soft pussy-bow neckline, long sleeves, in deep emerald (#0B6B4F), fabric: matte silk satin
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, full length to the top of the shoe, in ivory (#EFE8D8), fabric: lightweight wool crepe
Single-breasted blazer, slightly relaxed, hip length, in charcoal herringbone (#3A3A40), fabric: textured wool tweed
Straight-cut coat, knee length, in warm camel (#B98A5B), fabric: wool-cashmere blend
Loafers with a slightly chunky sole, in black (#1C1C1C), fabric: polished leather
Structured top-handle bag in burgundy (#6D1F2F), fabric: smooth calfskin
Chunky chain necklace and oval earrings in warm gold (#C9A24B), fabric: brushed metal

This outfit stays within a neat office dress code with its blouse, trousers, textured blazer and loafers, while the saturated emerald against ivory gives it a confident, memorable look. The herringbone blazer adds depth and keeps the bold color grounded and professional. The burgundy bag and gold jewelry add a rich autumn accent without making the look busy. The camel coat keeps you warm on the commute and completes a palette that reads polished and daring at the same time."}
